title: Resend editor window
description: A centred icon tile, lit title and lead over a wide editor window: a toolbar (styles button, the draft's name, a timestamp, a quiet test button and a bright send button) with a violet light on its top edge, then a message sheet with From/To/Subject rows, a banner slot and a blank white page with a hint. The window's frame fades into the black page while the sheet stays crisp.
notes: the email page is bg-foreground (white on the dark theme); on light themes it turns dark
banner and icon tile are media slots: placeholders until filled
name: resend-editor

props.name: title
props.description: the title; a list sets its desktop line breaks

props.name: text
props.description: the lead; a list sets its desktop line breaks

props.name: media
props.description: fills the icon slot above the title; empty shows a placeholder tile

props.name: toolbar
props.type: { styles: string; stylesIcon?: ReactNode; name: string; saved: string; test: string; send: string; }
props.description: the toolbar: styles button (label + icon), the draft's name, when it was saved, test and send labels

props.name: fields
props.description: the rows at the top of the message (From, To, Subject)

props.name: banner
props.description: the banner image at the top of the message; empty shows a placeholder

props.name: hint
props.description: the hint on the empty page
